## From species research to a sensible decision

Each group guide introduces lifespan, diet, personality, housing, vocalisation and suitability. Use this collection alongside our selection guide rather than treating appearance as the only consideration.

When you are ready to discuss a particular bird, the UK buying hub explains availability enquiries, price questions and the information to request before making a commitment.

## Start with the group. Compare the exact species

A Blue-and-gold Macaw and a smaller macaw are not interchangeable accommodation choices. Green-cheeked and Sun Conures can differ markedly in vocalisation. Congo African Grey and Timneh profiles describe related but distinct birds, and the small-parrot category spans several social patterns and lifespans. Explore a category, then follow its individual-species links.
